question: K.N. Shanth Kumar was elected chairman of which body from September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PTI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **K.N. Shanth Kumar** was elected chairman of the** Press Trust of India** (PTI) in September 2023.
 
• He is a veteran in media management and has been involved with The Printers (Mysore) Pvt. Ltd., which publishes leading newspapers like the Deccan Herald.
 
• He succeeded **Aveek Sarkar**, who served as PTI chairman for two consecutive terms.
 
• Shanth Kumar has been associated with **The Printers (Mysore) Pvt. Ltd**. since **1983 **and had previously served as **PTI **chairman from **2013 **to **2014**.
 
• Press Trust of India (PTI): Established in 1947, PTI is India's largest private news agency that provides news to major publications and channels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)**

 
 
• SEBI regulates the securities and commodity market in India to protect investors' interests and ensure market transparency.
 
• It enforces regulations to curb malpractices in **trading**, **oversees stock exchanges**, and approves **IPOs **and **mutual funds**.
 
• It is located in **Mumbai**, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development)**
 
 
• NABARD promotes sustainable rural development through **financing agriculture**, **rural infrastructure**, and **small-scale industries**.
 
• It provides financial assistance to **cooperative banks**, develops rural financial institutions, and implements government rural development schemes.
 
• It is located in **Mumbai**, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India)**
 
 
• BCCI governs cricket activities in India, including domestic and international matches.
 
• It organizes major tournaments like the IPL, appoints national team selectors, and manages cricket broadcasting rights.
 
• It is located in **Mumbai**, Maharashtra.
